name: Node-RED
description: Connect your own Node-RED runtimes to inspect and manage flows, settings, nodes, projects and library resources through the official Admin HTTP API, with Imperal health audits and safe deployment analysis.

tools.name: connect_node_red
tools.description: Connect a user-owned Node-RED runtime by verifying its HTTPS Admin API URL and access token before saving them.

base_url.description: HTTPS Node-RED editor/admin URL, e.g. https://flows.example.com.
base_url.title: Base Url

access_token.description: Node-RED Admin API access token with required permissions.
access_token.title: Access Token

tools.name: list_connections
tools.description: List connected Node-RED runtimes without exposing tokens.

tools.name: disconnect_node_red
tools.description: Disconnect one Node-RED runtime by deleting only its saved access token and URL; nothing changes in Node-RED.

tools.name: list_flows
tools.description: List Node-RED flow tabs from the connected runtime.

connection_id.description: Connection id from list_connections; omit only when one connection exists.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: get_flow
tools.description: Read one complete Node-RED flow by id.

connection_id.description: Connection id from list_connections; omit only when one connection exists.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: create_flow
tools.description: Create a Node-RED flow from an explicit complete flow object, then deploy according to the selected deployment type.

connection_id.description: Connection id from list_connections; omit only when one connection exists.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

flow.description: Complete Node-RED flow object, with explicit id/type/label/nodes fields.
flow.title: Flow

tools.name: update_flow
tools.description: Replace one Node-RED flow with the explicit supplied definition and deployment type.

connection_id.description: Connection id from list_connections; omit only when one connection exists.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

flow.description: Complete replacement flow object from get_flow, edited explicitly.
flow.title: Flow

tools.name: delete_flow
tools.description: Permanently delete one Node-RED flow. This removes the flow from the runtime.

connection_id.description: Connection id from list_connections; omit only when one connection exists.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: preview_flow_deployment
tools.description: Analyse a proposed flow locally before writing it to Node-RED; this makes no provider changes.

connection_id.description: Connection id from list_connections; omit only when one connection exists.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

flow.description: Proposed flow to analyse only; no provider write occurs.
flow.title: Flow

tools.name: list_nodes
tools.description: List installed Node-RED node modules and node definitions exposed by this runtime.

connection_id.description: Connection id from list_connections; omit only when one connection exists.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List Node-RED projects when projects are enabled on this runtime.

connection_id.description: Connection id from list_connections; omit only when one connection exists.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: get_runtime_settings
tools.description: Read safe Node-RED runtime settings and capability metadata.

connection_id.description: Connection id from list_connections; omit only when one connection exists.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: audit_node_red_runtime
tools.description: Build a read-only Node-RED health report: flow totals, disabled flows, node types and side-effect markers.

connection_id.description: Connection id from list_connections; omit only when one connection exists.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: list_credentials
tools.description: List Node-RED credential definitions/metadata only. Secret credential values are never requested or returned.

connection_id.description: Connection id from list_connections; omit only when one connection exists.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: get_node_module
tools.description: Read one installed Node-RED node module's public metadata by exact module name.

connection_id.description: Connection id from list_connections; omit only when one connection exists.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

module_name.description: Exact installed Node-RED module name from list_nodes.
module_name.title: Module Name

tools.name: install_node_module
tools.description: Install an explicit Node-RED node npm module. This changes runtime code and may require a restart/reload depending on the runtime.

connection_id.description: Connection id from list_connections; omit only when one connection exists.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

module_name.description: Exact npm package name for the Node-RED node module.
module_name.title: Module Name

version.description: Optional exact npm package version; omit for the provider default.
version.title: Version

tools.name: remove_node_module
tools.description: Remove an explicit Node-RED node module. This can disable flows that use its node types.

connection_id.description: Connection id from list_connections; omit only when one connection exists.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

module_name.description: Exact installed Node-RED module name from list_nodes.
module_name.title: Module Name

tools.name: list_library_entries
tools.description: List Node-RED library entries in an explicit safe library category and path.

connection_id.description: Connection id from list_connections; omit only when one connection exists.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: get_library_entry
tools.description: Read one explicit Node-RED library entry.

connection_id.description: Connection id from list_connections; omit only when one connection exists.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

path.description: Library entry path relative to its category.
path.title: Path

tools.name: write_library_entry
tools.description: Create or replace one explicit Node-RED library entry.

connection_id.description: Connection id from list_connections; omit only when one connection exists.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

path.description: Library entry path relative to its category.
path.title: Path

body.description: Complete text content for this library entry.
body.title: Body

tools.name: delete_library_entry
tools.description: Permanently delete one explicit Node-RED library entry.

connection_id.description: Connection id from list_connections; omit only when one connection exists.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

path.description: Library entry path relative to its category.
path.title: Path

tools.name: get_active_project
tools.description: Read the active Node-RED project when projects are enabled.

connection_id.description: Connection id from list_connections; omit only when one connection exists.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: create_project
tools.description: Create an explicit Node-RED project where the runtime exposes project management.

connection_id.description: Connection id from list_connections; omit only when one connection exists.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: activate_project
tools.description: Activate an explicit Node-RED project. This changes the runtime's active project and may reload flows.

connection_id.description: Connection id from list_connections; omit only when one connection exists.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: update_runtime_settings
tools.description: Update explicit provider-supported Node-RED runtime settings. Unsupported fields are rejected by Node-RED.

connection_id.description: Connection id from list_connections; omit only when one connection exists.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

secrets.name: node_red_connections
secrets.description: Vault-encrypted Node-RED Admin API connections. Managed by connect_node_red and never returned.
